cards.headline: The 'Banana' Defect
cards.context: ABS side caps arrived with 2.50mm warpage due to paint cure heat. Pilot line down.
cards.impact: Engineered 'Vertical Hanging' process to leverage gravity during cure. Deviation <0.5mm.

cards.headline: 51.8% Gross Margin
cards.context: Delivered $9,995 console despite 20% steel price hike and RoHS redesign.
cards.impact: Hit 51.8% GM vs 40% industry average. Removed ~$200/unit legacy royalty.

cards.headline: The 'No-Bid' Crisis
cards.context: Overseas vendor 'no-bidded' the complex top panel due to stud density. Schedule risk.
cards.impact: Executed rapid dual-source strategy with local vendor (Mass Precision) to bridge Pilot.

cards.headline: Headphone Jack Fire Drill
cards.context: Legacy design required 2-hour teardown to replace a 4.8% failure rate part.
cards.impact: Redesigned chassis for 'trap door' serviceability. Repair time dropped to 10 mins.

cards.headline: The 'Ratchet Strap' Assembly
cards.context: Press-induced bowing in sheet metal required installers to use ratchet straps to align units.
cards.impact: Redesigned tie-plates with ovalized holes to allow float. Eliminated field rigging.

cards.headline: Sticky Button Crisis
cards.context: Hardware insertion deformed plastic, causing fader buttons to stick.
cards.impact: Invented 'Post-Hardware Flattening' op to compress bowing without retooling mold.

cards.headline: AC Withdraw Failure
cards.context: Unit failed UL safety test 48 hours before shipping. Line Start halted.
cards.impact: Re-specified the AC harness bleeder (1 MOhm -> 750 kOhm) to drain the mains pins in time. NOA to FCS in nine days.

cards.headline: The Meltdown Mitigation
cards.context: Embedded CPU hit 75°C shutdown temperature during FOH testing. Show-stopper.
cards.impact: Re-architected chassis from 3U to 4U with custom ducting. Temp rise dropped to 22.6°C.

cards.headline: The 'No-Glue' Mandate
cards.context: Press-fit nuts were popping out. Vendor proposed glue. I rejected it.
cards.impact: Recalculated tolerance stack to .170 +0.00/-0.012 for perfect interference fit.

cards.headline: No Extrusions
cards.context: Target COGS <$15k required eliminating expensive aluminum extrusions.
cards.impact: Designed 'Origami Spine' from folded steel to match extrusion rigidity. Shipped on CNC folding -- stamping dies never committed.

cards.headline: The 'Hammered' Lid
cards.context: Pilot lids arrived 3mm too wide due to weldment error. Line Down risk.
cards.impact: Field fix: Manually hammered lids to pass EMI. Root cause fix: Modified blanking tool.

cards.headline: The 'Thumb of God' Fix
cards.context: Variable adhesive thickness caused 20°C CPU spikes. Hard hangs every 50 mins.
cards.impact: Switched to Phase Change Material (PCM) + 50psi clips. Delta dropped to 3°C.

cards.headline: 150W Thermal Crisis
cards.context: Desktop CPU + 3 Tuners in a set-top box. Smart Card reader hit 55°C (melting point).
cards.impact: Engineered 'Wind Tunnel' chassis with 28.3 CFM airflow. Stabilized CPU at 84°C.

cards.headline: The 'Hook 29' Fix
cards.context: Drawn standoffs caused 'potato chip' warping in the stampings.
cards.impact: Redesigned chassis floor with 'Hook 29' ribs to stabilize the steel.
